'''Xxan''' was a [[Water/Legends|water]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The underwater [[City/Legends|city]] [[Acquos]] was located on the world, and was connected to a small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the surface of the planet, via a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Plo Koon's Padawan|Jedi Padawan]] and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Trantos]] traveled to Xxan to meet with the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Zandoo]].
